cases.title: Structured math with declared supplemental glyphs
cases.text:
1.
Inline notation: $x_{i_j}^{2}+y_i^2=r^2$.
The operating return uses a clear stacked fraction.
$$\mathrm{ROIC}_{t}=\frac{\mathrm{NOPAT}_{t}}{\mathrm{IC}_{t}}$$
$$\mathrm{IC}_{t}=\mathrm{Inv}_{t}+\mathrm{AR}_{t}+\mathrm{PPE}_{t}-\mathrm{AP}_{t}$$

2.
Nested brackets, powers and Greek parameters.
$$\left\{\left[\frac{\alpha_{i,j}+\beta^{2}}{1+\sqrt{x_i^2+y_i^2}}\right]^2+\gamma\right\}$$

3.
Mean and variance with explicit summation limits.
$$\mu=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_i$$
$$\sigma^2=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(x_i-\mu\right)^2$$

4.
An indexed root and a definite integral.
$$\sqrt[3]{\frac{x^3+y^3}{1+\theta^2}}$$
$$\int_{0}^{1}x^2\,dx=\frac{1}{3}$$

5.
Partial derivatives and mixed lower indices.
$$H_{i,j}=\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_i\partial x_j}$$
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)^n$$

6.
Greek symbols use the supplemental handwriting set.
$$\alpha\;\beta\;\gamma\;\delta\;\epsilon\;\zeta\;\eta\;\theta\;\iota\;\kappa\;\lambda\;\mu$$
$$\nu\;\xi\;\omicron\;\pi\;\rho\;\sigma\;\tau\;\upsilon\;\phi\;\chi\;\psi\;\omega$$
$$\Gamma\;\Delta\;\Theta\;\Lambda\;\Xi\;\Pi\;\Sigma\;\Phi\;\Psi\;\Omega$$
Original symbols were not sampled; personal replacements can be added later.
